# Feature: products/detail (PROD)

## Overview

The product detail page (`/products/[id]`) and `GET /products/:id`: one product with its images, tags, reviews,
specifications, price and discount, stock. Used by every visitor (the app has no login).

Domain files: [states.md](../states.md) · [rules.md](../rules.md) · [history.md](../history.md)
